title: Wixen Mail - Project Roadmap
summary: Phased roadmap of Wixen Mail features with completion checkboxes, plus vision and success metrics.
notes: Status-tracking roadmap: checkbox feature lists across 8 phases, no ADR decision/consequences sections, no user stories or acceptance criteria, no API/schema contracts. 'Success Metrics' section (startup <2s, <100MB idle, 100% keyboard accessible, WCAG 2.2 Level AA, NVDA/JAWS/Narrator support) is a PRD-like signal but is one short section against a document that is otherwise progress tracking, so DOC over PRD. Threaded view is unticked with an explanation that the View menu item is disabled and nothing groups the list.
